label: peak_solar

solver.buoyancy_model: full buoyancy, incompressible ideal gas at the site pressure
solver.radiation_model: none, surfaces held at the EnergyPlus inside face temperatures

notes: Every grid point carries the value of the nearest solver cell. Grid points farther from any cell than the local cell spacing lie outside the air volume and are left empty rather than filled.
The surfaces were held at the inside face temperatures EnergyPlus reported for peak solar at 2019-01-24T15:00:00.

The steady solution did not settle (the volume average air temperature is still drifting, 0.033 K between the last two windows of 350 iterations), so the room was run in time with 2 s steps and 10 iterations per step after 60 s of spin up. This field is the average of 24 samples taken every 10 s over the final 240 s, and the speeds are time averaged speed magnitudes.

Convergence was judged on the solution rather than on scaled residuals, which plateau for air moved only by surface temperature differences: the time averaged air temperature drifted 0.013 K between two 120 s windows, and the time averaged air heat balance closed to 24.4 W.
The solve started from the air at the EnergyPlus zone air temperature.
Volume average air temperature 9.09 C against the 8.69 C EnergyPlus reported for the room as one well mixed volume.
The internal convective gain, infiltration and interzone mixing heat flows were applied as one uniform volumetric source totalling 496.1 W, so where leaks or occupants actually sit is not resolved.

source.citation: ANSYS Fluent 2026 R1, k-omega SST, 205,296 cells, run on the boundary conditions EnergyPlus exported for peak solar
